description: This file defines the class TemplateHTML, which extends TemplateField, and provides methods for rendering HTML fields in different contexts, handling database definitions, and setting field values within the SuiteCRM platform.

classes.name: TemplateHTML
classes.description: A class representing an HTML field in SuiteCRM, providing methods for rendering HTML in different views, handling database schema alterations, and setting default values.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sets specific property and calls parent save method to persist the field state.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns default value from ext4 if available, then calls parent set method.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns a HTML div with a title and placeholder for the field, used in detail views.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML used in edit views; currently same as detail view.

methods.name: get_html_list
methods.description: Returns HTML used in list views; currently same as detail view.

methods.name: get_html_search
methods.description: Returns HTML used in search views; currently same as detail view.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns the field content processed with nl2br for display in templates.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Returns the same as get_xtpl_detail for editing.

methods.name: get_xtpl_list
methods.description: Returns the same as get_xtpl_detail for list views.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Returns the same as get_xtpl_detail for search views.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, indicating no specific table alteration needed when adding.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, indicating no specific table alteration needed when modifying.

methods.name: get_db_delete_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, indicating no specific table alteration needed when deleting.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Builds and returns the database field definition array for this HTML field, including default value, type, and visibility settings.
